subject: PERFORM statement
notes: kb/Work/PB433.md - LANDED. Both halves of SR11 are enforced by ONE predicate at the range composition, where both ends are still resolutions carrying their owning SectionInfo: neither end declarative -> the rule's antecedent is false; either end declarative -> the two sections shall be the SAME object. COBOL2186, an error at every edition (the rule is X3.23-1985's, carried unchanged). The structural repair is that ResolveProcedureOperand now returns a ResolvedProcedure (range + owning section) instead of a naked pc pair, so the question SR11 asks is answerable at every procedure-name reference rather than re-derived from pc arithmetic; RESUME AT's nondeclarative test (SR-14.9.33.3-3) was converted from `Start < EntryPc` to the same field in the same change set. Witnesses: the two negatives are the loud half (one end in the declaratives, one outside - it used to compile clean and die of a stack overflow) and the quiet half (both ends declarative in DIFFERENT sections - it used to run and print a wrong answer); the 85 positive golden pins the three shapes the rule does NOT forbid (same declarative section, a one-name PERFORM of a declarative section, a wholly nondeclarative range), so the screen cannot widen into 'any PERFORM that touches the declaratives'.
